_doc: Free-form pilot record for R-7 / CP-5 (Technical_Specification_Graph_Rebuild.md §5.4, AC-043). Sizes in KB from du -sk inside the container; times in seconds from the run logs; full-build estimates are per-label throughput extrapolations, not measurements.

smoke_tests.constraints: all created (incl. Taxon.taxon_id, Attribute (name, value), GraphVersion.version)
smoke_tests.fulltext: token 'rangefinder' -> B004XYZI0Q found in 7 hits; fields title, description, features, details_text

validation.notes: R-07 lists 20 benchmark targets as absent because they are outside the 5% sample; the one sampled target (live_eval_laptop_02) keeps title, price, brand and category, reviews 33 -> 20 (cap).

full_build_estimate.note: Pilot review embedding ran at 164 texts/s (Neo4j round trips included) vs 335 texts/s in the P-04 encode-only benchmark.
